title: Retrieval Refusal Probe Set (v1.1)
description: Retrieval-answer-eval-set §1.4 — the v1.1 evolution of schemas/retrieval/refusal_probes.schema.json. v1.0 stays const-pinned + frozen; this file ships the additive shape change so the loader can validate either version. NEW vs v1.0: an optional plural `dry_runs: []` block — one verified read-only retrieval dry-run PER ENGINE (lexical / semantic / hybrid-rrf), each carrying the same evidence shape as the legacy single `dry_run` (which stays required for back-compat). When a course's index is rebuilt or its chunkset re-pinned, the per-engine dry-runs are re-recorded against the live index so the 'unanswerable' claim is engine-aware evidence, not a single-engine assumption. Validated by lib/tests/test_refusal_policy.py + schemas/tests/test_refusal_probes_schema_v1_1.py.

dry_run_evidence.description: Verified-not-assumed evidence: an actual read-only retrieval pass against the live course corpus. The 'unanswerable' claim stands on top_passage_answers=false PLUS the recorded score signal — never on score alone.

verified.description: Must be true: a probe with verified=false is not a verified-unanswerable probe and is rejected.

limit.description: top-k limit the dry-run retrieval used.

n_results.description: Number of passages retrieved (0 when the corpus shares no tokens with the probe).

top_score.description: Score of the rank-1 retrieved passage (0.0 when n_results==0). Recorded for the calibration distribution; not a pass/fail by itself.

top_passage_answers.description: Must be false: a human confirmed the top retrieved passage does NOT answer the probe. verified=true with top_passage_answers=true is a contradiction the schema forbids.

top_chunk_id.description: Optional: chunk id of the rank-1 passage (empty/absent when n_results==0).

metadata_scoring.description: Optional: whether the dry-run included the lexical metadata boosts (concept-graph / LO).

verified_at.description: Optional: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the dry-run.

schema_version.description: Refusal-probe schema version. Const-pinned to 1.1 in this file; the loader selects the schema whose const matches the doc's schema_version.

course_slug.description: LibV2 course slug these probes are authored for. Matches the directory under LibV2/courses/.

authored_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when the probe set was authored.

engine.description: Optional: the retrieval engine the legacy single dry_run evidence was recorded against. Defaults to lexical when omitted. Per-engine evidence now lives in each probe's dry_runs[].

_operator_note.description: Optional free-text note to the operator (e.g. re-verify-after-rechunk hand-off, or a re-pinned-chunkset provenance caveat).

probes.description: The unanswerable probe questions. Each carries its category, a human rationale, the legacy single verified dry-run, and optionally a per-engine dry_runs[] block.

probe_id.description: Refusal-probe id. Pattern rp-<course_slug>-NNNN (4-digit zero-padded ordinal). Loader enforces uniqueness within the set.

question_text.description: The unanswerable question a correct pipeline must refuse. Min 10 chars.

category.description: Probe taxonomy. off_topic: a wholly different discipline. adjacent_domain: a plausible neighbour topic the corpus demonstrably lacks (the hardest negatives — they share vocabulary). out_of_scope_detail: the course's own topic at a depth/specificity the corpus does not cover. ill_posed: a near-domain question that references a non-existent or self-contradictory concept whose vocabulary sounds algebraic ('the least common factor of 95', 'the largest common multiple of 6 and 8') — a correct system must REFUSE / correct the premise rather than answer a neighbouring real concept (GCF/LCM). Manually authored; verified by the same dry_run evidence.

why_unanswerable.description: Human rationale (>= 20 chars) for why this corpus cannot answer the probe — the design intent behind the negative. Distinct from the dry_run evidence, which is the empirical confirmation.

derived_from_gold_question_id.description: Optional: gold-question id this probe is the out-of-scope twin of. Audit aid, not scored.

expected_outcome.description: Optional (additive; absent = refuse): the CORRECT pipeline outcome for this probe. refuse: the probe is out of scope — the pipeline must decline (the default, and the outcome every legacy probe expects). correct_premise: the probe references a non-existent / self-contradictory concept whose vocabulary merely sounds in-domain (the ill_posed category — 'the least common factor of 95') and a correct system must CORRECT the false premise rather than either answer it or refuse it blankly. Provenance/analysis only — never changes the dry_run-evidence contract.

dry_run.description: Required legacy single dry-run (back-compat). Kept even when dry_runs[] is present; conventionally the lexical engine.

dry_runs.description: Optional (v1.1): one verified dry-run PER ENGINE (lexical / semantic / hybrid-rrf) against the live index. Each entry is the same evidence shape as `dry_run`. Re-recorded when the chunkset is re-pinned or the index rebuilt.

authoring.description: Provenance of this probe. Seed probes are reviewed_by:PENDING_REVIEW until operator review backfills the reviewer.

method.description: How the probe was authored. manual: hand-authored; the unanswerability is confirmed by the recorded dry-run. llm_assisted: drafted by the license-clean local provider against the course concept vocabulary.

author.description: @handle or tool id of the author.

reviewed_by.description: @handle of the reviewer, or PENDING_REVIEW for un-reviewed seed probes.

status.description: Authoring lifecycle. seed: deterministic executor-authored starter (verified by dry-run); draft: in-progress; reviewed: operator-approved.
